name: Module Selection
description: Declares one Site module and the optional capabilities requested within it.
purpose: Makes Site functionality explicit and machine-readable while leaving Module dependencies and canonical capabilities to Phase 17.

fields.description: Whether the module is requested for this Site.

relationships.description: Module selection may contain capability selections.
Phase 17 Module Registry is authoritative for module/capability existence and dependencies.

validationRules.description: moduleId values must be unique within one Site Manifest.
A disabled Module cannot contain enabled capabilities.
Module and capability IDs must exist in the Phase 17 Module Registry and satisfy dependency/ownership rules.

delivery.notes: Manifest definitions contain technical declarations only. Secret values are prohibited.
